definitions.explanation: The act of sending out goods, packages, or mail to a destination.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}を{発送|はっそう}した。
{注文|ちゅうもん}した{品物|しなもの}は{明日|あした}{発送|はっそう}される{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: The item you ordered is scheduled to be shipped tomorrow.

examples.japanese: {発送|はっそう}{後|ご}のキャンセルはできませんので、{住所|じゅうしょ}を{確認|かくにん}してから{注文|ちゅうもん}してください。
examples.english: Cancellations are not possible after shipping, so please confirm your address before ordering.

notes:
{発送|はっそう} means to send out or dispatch goods, packages, or mail. Commonly used in online shopping, postal services, and business logistics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {荷物|にもつ}を{発送|はっそう}する: to ship a package
- {商品|しょうひん}を{発送|はっそう}する: to ship a product
- {発送|はっそう}{日|び}: shipping date
- {発送|はっそう}{済|ず}み: already shipped
- {発送|はっそう}{手続|てつづ}き: shipping procedures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {送|おく}る: to send (general, everyday)
- {発送|はっそう}: to ship/dispatch (formal, business context)
- {配送|はいそう}: delivery (focuses on the delivery to the recipient)
- {出荷|しゅっか}: shipment from warehouse (business/manufacturing term)

USAGE:
Often seen in online shopping notifications: ご{注文|ちゅうもん}の{商品|しょうひん}を{発送|はっそう}しました (Your ordered item has been shipped). The noun form is common in compound expressions like {発送|はっそう}{元|もと} (shipping origin/sender).
